name: Magnetic Boots
description: Heavy metallic footwear that allows you to walk on walls and ceilings of ferrous structures, leaving spark trails behind

name: Cyber Dash
description: Neural implant that overclocks your movement processors, allowing you to dash through short distances in a blur of static

name: Double Jump Boosters
description: Compact rocket thrusters mounted on your back that provide a second burst of propulsion while airborne

name: Phase Cloak
description: Experimental technology that shifts your molecular frequency, allowing brief passage through solid matter

name: Adrenaline Injector
description: Automated medical system that floods your bloodstream with combat stimulants when health drops below critical levels

name: Hack Roll
description: Combat subroutine that temporarily digitizes your body, allowing you to roll through enemies and obstacles as a data stream

name: Shock Absorption Gel
description: Bioengineered padding that hardens on impact, completely negating fall damage and reducing collision injuries

name: Network Tap
description: Portable device that can interface with any electronic lock, door, or terminal through wireless infiltration protocols

name: Atmospheric Scanner
description: Multi-spectrum analyzer that reveals hidden passages, weak structural points, and environmental hazards through augmented reality

name: Wall Crawler Nanobots
description: Microscopic robots that coat your hands and feet, allowing you to climb any surface like a mechanical spider

name: Sonic Pulser
description: Wrist-mounted device that generates focused sound waves capable of shattering glass and stunning electronic systems

name: Memory Extractor
description: Neural interface that can download and view the final moments of deceased androids and cyborgs

name: Thermal Vision Implants
description: Cybernetic eye modifications that reveal heat signatures through walls and detect invisible laser security systems

name: Electromagnetic Pulse
description: Shoulder-mounted generator that can disable all electronics in a wide radius, though it drains your own power systems

name: Gravity Manipulator
description: Experimental wrist device that can temporarily alter local gravity, allowing you to walk on walls or create zero-G fields

name: Data Dive
description: Ability to temporarily upload your consciousness into the global network, moving instantly between connected terminals

name: Reactive Armor Plates
description: Smart armor that automatically shifts and adjusts to absorb incoming damage, becoming temporarily stronger with each hit

name: Signal Jammer
description: Personal ECM device that makes you invisible to electronic detection while scrambling nearby communication systems

name: Nano Repair Swarm
description: Self-replicating repair bots that slowly restore your health and fix damaged equipment over time

name: Overclock Protocol
description: Emergency subroutine that temporarily doubles your processing speed, making everything else appear to move in slow motion

name: Plasma Cutter Arm
description: Retractable limb modification that can slice through most materials and create new pathways through obstacles

name: Stealth Field Generator
description: Energy-intensive device that bends light around your body, rendering you nearly invisible for short periods

name: Biometric Spoofer
description: Sophisticated device that can replicate any fingerprint, retinal pattern, or DNA signature for accessing secure areas

name: Quantum Entangler
description: Rare technology that creates a temporary link between two locations, allowing instantaneous travel across short distances

name: Neural Bridge
description: Ability to directly interface with any AI or computer system through thought alone, bypassing traditional input methods

name: Radiation Immunity
description: Genetic modification that allows you to walk through toxic zones and radioactive areas without any protective equipment

name: Underwater Breathing
description: Artificial gill implants that extract oxygen from any liquid, allowing indefinite exploration of flooded areas

name: Faction Diplomacy
description: Social programming that allows you to negotiate safe passage through bandit camps and hostile settlements

name: Machine Whisperer
description: Neural interface that lets you communicate with and command autonomous robots and factory systems

name: Seismic Slam
description: Hydraulic leg enhancers that can create shockwaves to break through weak floors and stun nearby enemies

name: Photosynthetic Skin
description: Bioengineered skin modification that slowly regenerates health when exposed to any form of artificial or natural light

name: Tunnel Vision
description: Echolocation implants that reveal hidden passages and structural weaknesses through sonar mapping

name: Trade Network Access
description: Encrypted communication device that connects you to merchant networks for buying and selling rare components

name: Toxic Resistance
description: Liver and lung modifications that neutralize most chemical hazards and allow breathing in contaminated atmospheres

name: Solar Charging
description: Photovoltaic skin patches that convert any light source into power for your cybernetic systems

name: Vault Breaker
description: Specialized tool set designed specifically for opening pre-war security doors and corporate safes

name: Animal Companion Link
description: Pheromone dispenser and neural transmitter that allows you to befriend and communicate with mutant creatures

name: Scrap Crafting
description: Integrated fabrication tools in your arms that can combine junk items into useful equipment and ammunition

name: Deep Diving Gear
description: Pressure suit and breathing apparatus that enables exploration of flooded underground complexes
